title: Piping material.
officialText:
Installations of natural gas piping operating at pressures of 125 psig (861.8 kPa gauge) and above shall comply with the requirements of ASME B31.1.

(Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)
